units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 65b:9">Snh. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>הנשאל בג׳</he> he who consults a skull (as a conjurer).

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:6">Koh. R. to XII, 6</cite> ‘the golden bowl’ (<he>גולת</he> <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:6">ib.</cite>) is the head (bowed down in old age); a. e.—Pl. <he>גּוּלְגֹלִיּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19">Num. R. s. 19</cite>; Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 20 <he>ג׳ וזרועות וכ׳</he> innumerable skulls, arms &c.
Y. Keth. X, end, 34ᵃ; ib. XIII, 35ᵈ, v. אַרְנוֹנָא. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 1; a. fr.—Pl. as above.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:18">Y. Peah I, 15ᵇ</cite> bot.—Yalk. Dan. 1061, v. <cite ref="C00380">preced.</cite>; a. fr.
